nurse.text: Now then, love! Welcome to Whitby Sanctuary. Pop your team on the counter and I'll see them right. They look like they've climbed all 199 steps.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Sit thissen down. There's a pot of tea, a plate of parkin, and a view of the harbour. If a seagull takes the parkin, that's tradition.
There! That's champion. Right as rain, which round here is a state of mind. Mind how you go, and watch the bench, there's a hat on it.
The Ark's in the corner, love. It's got a faint smell of sea air and a very polite fish on the lid. Go on, have a click.

else.text: No bother at all, love. Off you pop, and give my regards to the steps.
